open_work: The original work-top datum stays at 1.16m. A bounded front-corner notch clears the retained poison cupboard with 10mm plan separation; the remaining counter face, supports and screened rear edge are fabricated inside the original plan.

Three original round ranks move above the balance case: shelf bases 1.74/2.22/2.70m, jar bases 1.775/2.255/2.735m, original jar height 0.34m. Their original Yn centres and identities remain; X centres become 23.57m. Shelf depth fits the bottles and their original Yn rear boundary remains.
The balance case seats on the unchanged work-top datum, with a passive enclosed balance and thin fixed glazing. No calibration, grinding, dispensing, poison custody or medical operation is claimed.
Poison cupboard/bottles, carboys and fountain retain subsequent fabrication owners; engineering capacity, independent utilities and continuous routes remain separate evidence.
